answer: Each agent key bonds 100 tokens, locked for 90 days. The ledger counts keys convicted by fraud proofs in one 30-day window, and when a tide of proofs lands, each loses 3% × k² of its bond. If six fakes sell bogus glacier-melt forecasts at once, the 2nd conviction lifts every cut to 12% and the 6th to 100%. Acting in parallel puts fakes in one window, staggering them stalls the attack, and locked bonds can't be reused. A lone agent misquoting a lantern order loses 3 tokens.
